question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Siddhartha, Bob gets Jane Eyre, and Claire gets Beloved.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Claire swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Finally, Alice and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Siddhartha
(B) Jane Eyre
(C) Beloved
solution:
Books in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (Siddhartha, Jane Eyre, Beloved)
1. Swap Bob and Claire: (Siddhartha, Beloved, Jane Eyre)
2. Swap Bob and Claire: (Siddhartha, Jane Eyre, Beloved)
3. Swap Alice and Bob: (Jane Eyre, Siddhartha, Beloved)
Claire has Beloved, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
